summary: A centred 1080×1080 light composition: a #eeeeee backdrop with a faint 3×3 grid of hairlines (x≈234/847, y≈234/847). It holds one off-white card (#f9f9f9, ~16px radius, soft white rim and very soft shadow) at [293,286,494,509]. Inside the card's top is an inset illustration panel [302,295,476,291] with a barely visible 1px border. It shows a skeuomorphic grey GPU: a brushed-silver rounded board [370,382,237,100] with two dark 7-blade fans in grey rings, four dark corner screws, and white heatsink fin strips peeking above and below. A row of tiny tick dots runs above it, and a long soft drop shadow falls toward the lower right. A short black cable runs from the right side into a small square port plate with four screws and a dark round socket. Below, left-aligned at x=321, sit the black semibold title "GPU Pods", two lines of mid-grey body copy, and a dark near-black gradient "Deploy Pod" button (~8px radius, white label, soft drop shadow). Motion: at 0s the panel is empty. From ~0.1s to 0.3s a pale, flat, low-contrast GPU fades in with its tick rows. Around 0.3–0.5s a pale port plate and cable appear to the right. From ~0.5s to 1.0s the drawing gains depth: fans darken, screws, fins and shadow appear, the cable turns black, and the plate settles ~5px left to x≈645. From then to 7.8s the only motion is both fans spinning continuously. Card, text and button never move.

criteria.check: Background is a flat light grey (~#eeeeee), not white
Faint thin grid lines cross the backdrop at about x=234, x=847, y=234 and y=847
Card spans about x 293–787, y 286–795 and is centred in the frame
Card is off-white (~#f9f9f9), slightly lighter than the backdrop, with rounded corners ~16px
Card edge reads as a soft white rim and diffuse shadow, with no dark or hard outline stroke
Inset panel occupies the card's top about x 302–778, y 295–586, ending ~24px above the title
Panel boundary is a barely visible 1px light-grey line with rounded corners, same fill as the card
GPU board rectangle spans about x 370–607, y 382–482 inside the panel
Board is a silver metal face with a light-to-darker grey gradient, a thin grey edge and ~10px radius, not a flat single colour
Exactly two round fans sit side by side on the board, centres near (437,431) and (540,431)
Each fan has a light grey outer ring, dark grey curved blades and a light hub with a ring around a pale centre
Fan shows about 7 curved, swept blades (6–8), not straight spokes
Four dark round screws sit at the board's four corners
A white fin strip shows above the board's top edge, topped by a row of tiny tick dots near y≈364
A white segmented fin strip shows under the board's bottom edge, about y 482–498
A soft blurred grey shadow falls to the lower right of the GPU, extending to about x 650, y 530; no hard-edged shadow shape
A short black cable with a collar joins the board's right edge to the port plate at about y 431
Port plate is a small rounded white square at about x 645–710, y 399–465
Port plate has four small grey screws at its corners and a dark round socket in its centre
Title reads exactly "GPU Pods"
Title is near-black, semibold, about 26px, left edge at x≈321
Body reads "Deploy a dedicated GPU environment for AI" on line 1 and "development, testing, and model fine-tuning." on line 2
Body text is mid-grey (~#8c8c8c), clearly lighter than the title, about 17px with ~27px line spacing
Button spans about x 321–448, y 720–766, left-aligned with the title
Button fill is near-black with a subtle top-lighter vertical gradient and ~8px corner radius
Button label reads "Deploy Pod" in white, ~16px, centred
Button casts a soft grey drop shadow below it
At the very start the illustration panel is empty: no GPU, cable or plate visible
Card, title, body and button are already fully visible at 0s (no entrance for the text block)
Between 0s and 0.3s a pale, low-contrast flat GPU (board, two light-grey fans, tick rows above and below) appears in the panel
At 0.25s the GPU is still flat and pale: no screws, no shadow, light grey fans
The port plate and a grey cable are absent at 0.25s and present (still pale) by 0.5s, plate at about x 650–715
Between 0.5s and 1.0s the GPU gains depth: fans darken, corner screws, heatsink fins and the lower-right drop shadow appear
Between 0.5s and 1.0s the cable turns from mid grey to black and the port plate settles ~5px left (to x≈645)
The GPU illustration has finished building by ~1.0s and looks the same at 1.0s and 2.5s apart from the fans
The left fan's blades rotate between 3.9s and 4.4s while the fan ring stays in place
The right fan's blades rotate between 3.9s and 4.4s
Fans are still spinning near the end of the clip (blade positions differ between 7.0s and 7.5s)
After 1s the board, screws, cable and plate do not move; only fan blades change between 3.9s and 4.4s
Card, title, body copy and button do not move or change across the whole clip
GPU is drawn as a clean skeuomorphic vector (gradients, soft shadow), not a photo, and matches the clip's silhouette: board, 2 fans, fins, cable, plate
Whole illustration stays greyscale: no colour hues anywhere
